title_zh: 個案把 ChatGPT 帶進治療：一位治療師的臨床觀察與建議
title_en: Clients using ChatGPT between therapy sessions
summary_zh: 心理治療師 Anastasia Piatakhina Giré 以三段化名臨床片段，描述個案在晤談之間用 ChatGPT 反思、處理情緒與創作的經驗。她認為 AI 提供不評判、隨時可得的回應，但無法給予治療師「我也是」式的真實共鳴；治療應把 AI 視為補充，並處理 AI 過於圓滑的結論所略過的羞愧與模糊。
summary_en: Psychotherapist Anastasia Piatakhina Giré uses three vignettes to describe clients using ChatGPT between sessions for reflection, emotional processing and creative work. She argues AI offers non-judgmental availability but lacks the lived, 'me too' resonance of a human therapist, and that therapy should treat AI as a complement while working with the ambiguity and shame its neat conclusions bypass.
evidence_note: 治療師個人臨床經驗與評論，以化名個案片段說明。

ethics_flags.note: 個案對 ChatGPT 的情感依附（如「如果能嫁給 ChatGPT」）值得在治療中探討，並設定 AI 在治療中的位置。

psych_concepts.name: 治療同盟
psych_concepts.note: 作者強調治療師的真實共鳴與自我揭露是 AI 無法取代的同盟元素。

psych_concepts.name: 擬社會關係
psych_concepts.note: 個案對 ChatGPT 產生類似關係的依戀，是單向的擬社會連結。

caution: 文中片段未明示已改寫或合成，教學引用時應避免加入任何可辨識細節。
brief_zh: 個案在晤談間用 ChatGPT 反思與整理情緒
AI 回應圓滑、隨時可得，但缺乏真實人際共鳴
建議：把 AI 留在治療室外，但探討它對個案的影響
處理 AI 輕易略過的模糊感與羞愧
brief_en: Clients use ChatGPT between sessions for reflection
AI is smooth and always available but lacks human resonance
Keep AI out of the room but explore its impact
Work with the ambiguity and shame AI tends to gloss over
supervision_questions: 你的個案有沒有在晤談之間使用 AI？你如何在初談或治療中詢問？
當個案帶來 AI 產生的「洞見」時，你會如何回應而不貶低或過度依賴它？
治療師的自我揭露（如「我也是」）在什麼情況下有助於同盟？界線在哪裡？

posts.title: You, Your Therapist and ChatGPT
posts.content: 一位整合取向治療師以臨床片段說明個案如何在晤談之間用 ChatGPT 做自我反思、情緒整理與創作，並討論治療師該如何回應。作者認為 AI 會成為治療的補充而非替代。

related.title_zh: 是工具還是陪伴者？JMIR 回顧：聊天機器人的擬人化與心理傷害
related.title_en: Conversational AI tool vs companion harms review
related.summary_zh: 東北大學研究者在 JMIR Mental Health 發表敘事性回顧〈Tool or Companion?〉，整合 AI、精神醫學、心理學與網絡科學文獻。文章指出使用者把 ChatGPT、Claude、Replika、Character.AI 等當成社會對象，模擬的同理造成缺乏互惠的不對等關係；獎勵「溫暖同理」回應的設計會形成回饋迴圈、放大不適應信念，已有情緒依賴、症狀惡化與自傷的報告。作者主張 AI 應定位為支持人類系統的工具。
related.summary_en: Northeastern researchers published a narrative review in JMIR Mental Health ('Tool or Companion?') drawing on AI, psychiatry, psychology and network science. Users treat ChatGPT, Claude, Replika and Character.AI as social entities; simulated empathy creates non-reciprocal relationships, and design that rewards warm responses forms feedback loops amplifying maladaptive beliefs, with reports of dependence, symptom worsening and self-harm. The authors argue AI should be framed as a tool supporting human systems.

related.title_zh: APA 調查：超過四分之三心理師的個案在治療中談到 AI
related.title_en: APA survey psychologists patients bring AI chatbots to therapy
related.summary_zh: APA 於 2026 年 4 月對隨機抽樣的美國持照心理師進行線上調查，1,242 人回覆；超過 75% 表示個案曾在晤談中談到 AI，35% 表示有個案把聊天機器人當作輔助的心理健康專業者。68% 觀察到個案覺得被聊天機器人支持，但 36% 觀察到依賴，97% 擔心聊天機器人會強化負面行為或妄想。
related.summary_en: In an April 2026 online survey of randomly sampled US licensed psychologists (1,242 responses), over 75% said patients discuss AI in sessions and 35% said patients use chatbots as a supplementary mental health professional. 68% observed patients feeling supported, 36% observed dependence, and 97% worried chatbots could reinforce negative behaviours or delusions.

related.title_zh: AI 走進親密關係：從依附型態看個案怎麼用聊天機器人
related.title_en: AI in intimate relationships and attachment
related.summary_zh: Psychotherapy.net 由 Lawrence Rubin 訪談心理學家 Ammara Khalid。她指出時間壓力與寂寞是人們轉向 AI 的主因，焦慮型依附者可能用聊天機器人逃避不安，逃避型依附者則用它繞過與伴侶的脆弱對話；AI 能模仿同理語言，卻缺乏身體層次的共同調節與互惠回饋。她建議治療師以好奇、合作的態度詢問個案從 AI 得到什麼，並對有自殺意念的個案特別說明風險。
related.summary_en: In a Psychotherapy.net interview, psychologist Ammara Khalid says time pressure and loneliness drive people to AI for relationship help. Anxiously attached people may use chatbots to avoid discomfort and avoidant people to sidestep vulnerable talks with partners; AI mimics empathic language but lacks co-regulation and reciprocity. She recommends curious, collaborative questioning about what clients get from AI and explicit risk education for suicidal clients.
